Publishing the pkgdown website

Source: PKGDOWN-SETUP.md

The website is built by .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml and published to the gh-pages branch. One-time setup:

  1. Source on main. The package source (R/, man/, vignettes/, DESCRIPTION, _pkgdown.yml, .github/…) must live on the main branch. gh-pages must only contain the generated site (the workflow creates it).
  2. Workflow. Keep .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml on main.
  3. GitHub Pages. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source: Deploy from a branch, Branch: gh-pages, folder / (root).
  4. Permissions. Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions: Read and write permissions.
  5. Push to main (or run the workflow from the Actions tab). After it ends in green, the site is at https://cbgarciaugr.github.io/multiCollglm/.

Build it locally with:

install.packages(c("pkgdown", "VisCollin", "TH.data", "rvif", "glmnet"))
pkgdown::build_site()      # writes docs/ (ignored by git and by R CMD build)

To add an example: copy vignettes/articles/reproduction-template.Rmd, then list it in _pkgdown.yml (the articles: section and the Examples menu in navbar:) and in the table of vignettes/articles/examples.Rmd.
